# SwarmOS TUI v1.23.2

This release establishes the canonical SwarmOS TUI release channel with
verified native binaries for Linux, macOS, and Windows.

## Highlights

- Adds immutable, versioned TUI releases published from the private monorepo to
  the public `Swarm-Code/swarm-releases` distribution repository.
- Publishes native Linux amd64/arm64, macOS amd64/arm64, and Windows amd64
  executables.
- Adds mandatory SHA-256 verification for updater downloads.
- Aligns the compiled version, source tag, public release tag, release asset
  names, and update checker.
- Preserves the recent startup, compaction, SDK bootstrap, and remote-session
  improvements included in the canonical monorepo.

## Verification

Every executable is built on its native GitHub-hosted runner, executes its own
`--version` check before publication, and is accompanied by a platform-specific
SHA-256 file. The release also includes a combined `checksums.txt` manifest and
the exact embedded Go module dependency inventory. An SPDX JSON SBOM and public
GitHub-signed SLSA provenance and SBOM bundles provide anonymously verifiable
supply-chain evidence for all five executables.

Source release tag: `tui/v1.23.2`
